comment: Pinned external references for XET conformance. Bump only with a fixture refresh; CI verifies fixture hashes against tests/data/xet/manifest.json.

external_cas_live_test.note: External CAS used for the G9 live gate cross-test (fallback: stubbi/openxet needs a Rust source build). ccbt CasHttpClient and hf_xet both round-tripped byte-identically against it, and the file hash matched ccbt's own CAS. Verified locally 2026-11-15 via dev/scripts/run_xet_live_gate.py; not exercised in CI.

reference_corpus.note: Large upstream sample file is not vendored; synthetic vectors in tests/data/xet/synthetic_vectors.json are generated deterministically (seeded) and hashed in the manifest. Refresh procedure: regenerate fixtures, update manifest hashes, run golden tests.
